mapper.select:
select t1.*, t2.ASSETNAME,t2.SPECIFICATIONTYPE,t2.MEASUREMENT,t2.DISCONTINUEDTIME from TBL_CEA_ASSET_ADJUSTMENT t1 inner join TBL_CEA_ASSET_MGT t2 on t1.ASSETMGTID=t2.id where 1=1 and (t1.creator = #{param.creator}
or t1.creator in (SELECT DISTINCT STAFFID FROM TBL_USER_ORGRELATION WHERE DEPTID IN (${param.getDeptIds})) )
and t2.ASSETNAME like concat('%',concat(#{param.assetMgtName},'%'))
order by t1.id desc
